outcome: Neurogenesis (migration, proliferation, differentiation to neurons, astrocytes, oligodendrocytes)
cohort: Neural progenitor cells were isolated from newborn (PND0) rabbit brains after surgical IUGR induction or control conditions in pregnant rabbits.
finding: Neurospheres derived from IUGR brains showed significant impairment in oligodendrocyte differentiation, which could be reverted by in vitro exposure to thyroid hormone.
